description: T2 inverse thermometer: measured net soft half-step width ratio R = W_net/W_net_det -> Gamma -> T_e.
scope_limit: A filling is only calibrated if a T1 run exists at its own Omega. Rows with calibrated=false apply the nu = -2.4 (Omega = 5) curve at a filling whose Omega differs (Omega(nu) runs 5.0 -> 13.9); that is an explicit extrapolation, not a measured calibration. Run scripts/run_thermometry_calibration.py --nu <nu> to convert a row to calibrated=true.
estimator: W_soft = Int exp(-((v-v_target)/sigma_k)^2/2) d i_dc, control-subtracted against a sinusoidal CPR at the same Gamma; R = W_net / W_net_det.
slope_estimator: weighted local linear regression in ln(Gamma), bandwidth 0.3; used only for error propagation (sigma_T ~ 1/|dR/dGamma|). The PCHIP derivative is C0 across knots and would print the knot spacing onto the reported resolution.

reference_inverse_table.note: nu = -2.4 curve; other fillings with their own calibration use theirs, see fillings[].calibration_source
